USE nyc_taxi_gold;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.dim_date AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'dim_date/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'gold_storage',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS result;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.dim_location AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'dim_location/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'gold_storage',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS result
WHERE is_current = 1;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.dim_vendor AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'dim_vendor/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'gold_storage',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS result;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.dim_weather AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'dim_weather/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'gold_storage',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS result;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.fact_trips AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'fact_trips/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'gold_storage',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS result;
GO
